title: TWDisaster events.csv row
description: Apply to a CSV row after reading every cell as UTF-8 text. Empty cells represent unknown or unavailable values unless the field description says otherwise.

aliases_json.description: JSON array of distinct historical aliases; [] means none recorded.

event_type.description: Reported disaster type, such as typhoon or heavy_rain.

start_date.description: Earliest start date among included source report windows; empty when unknown.

end_date.description: Latest end date among included source report windows; empty when unknown.

time_precision.description: Precision of the compiled report window.

reported_areas_json.description: JSON array of administrative areas mentioned by included observations, not an event footprint.
